learning_outcomes.text: Describes the role of an engineer in a project team.
Calculates, designs and presents a mechanism.
Calculates, designs and presents a whole system.
Studies on a project and presents.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Comp. Aided Design. Advantage of the solid modeling.
2D design. Placing 2D geometrical constraints and dimensions to a sketch.
Creating details on solid bodies such as holes, rounding, chamfering. Creation and selection of working planes and applications. Advanced sold model.
Creation and selection of working planes and applications.
Advanced solid modeling commands, sweep, loft, intersection.
Obtaining technical drawings from a solid model. Dimensioning.
Standard parts and their usages. Bolts, bearings, profiles, sealing elements, lubricators etc.
Standard parts and their usages. Bolts, bearings, profiles, sealing elements, lubricators etc.
